case.pattern_description: Coordinated shared-device ring: a single mobile device fingerprint, always reached through an anonymising proxy, appears on many unrelated cardholders' accounts within a few weeks and is marked New for every one of them. It was found by pivoting from the flagged transaction to the device profile vertex and counting distinct cards on it inside the alert window, then checking the New-device and proxy flags across the device's whole history.

sar.narrative: Customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1. Between 2016-11-22 and 2016-11-22, 3 transaction(s) totalling $439.61 were identified as part of a single suspected fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3460634. The activity was conducted online under product code C, billed in region 191, from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080'. Device profile shared by 28 unrelated cards within 30 days, marked new for 100% of the transactions it ever appears on, and consistently behind ip_proxy:anonymous. The cardholder's established profile over 71 prior transactions shows a median amount of $55.92 and a maximum of $225.94. The same device profile was used on 27 other cardholders' cards inside the same window, indicating a common actor across multiple customers rather than an isolated compromise. Closed investigation(s) CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985 record comparable activity previously confirmed by this institution. The institution's detection model scored the flagged transaction only 0.05; the suspicion arises from the relationship evidence, not from the model score. The institution's recommended disposition is: BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST. Actions requiring team-lead or fraud-manager approval are recorded as awaiting approval and have not been executed.
